title: Development loop against stated intent
description: Three critics assess a body of work blind against the photographer's own stated aims, a rubric teacher calibrates them and issues the next assignment, and the loop warns rather than stops when the bound is reached.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-photo-06
  title: Development loop against stated intent
  description: Three critics assess a body of work blind against the photographer's own stated aims, a
    rubric teacher calibrates them and issues the next assignment, and the loop warns rather than stops
    when the bound is reached.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give a developing photographer a repeatable read on their own work against their own stated
    aims, where reaching the iteration bound reports as still developing rather than as a failure.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: A body of work and the photographer's stated aims
      summary: A body of work and the photographer's stated aims
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - assets
          - instructions
        properties:
          assets:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            maxItems: 12
            items:
              type: object
              required:
                - uri
                - mediaType
              properties:
                uri:
                  type: string
                  description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier,
                    or authorized HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
                mediaType:
                  type: string
                  pattern: ^(image|audio|video|application)/
                name:
                  type: string
          instructions:
            type: string
          sourceRights:
            type: string
            description: User-supplied rights, consent, release, or provenance context when relevant.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - stated_aims
              - genre
              - work_period
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              stated_aims: {}
              genre: {}
              work_period: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-01
      name: Light and exposure assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Critic reading the light in a frame — quality, direction, ratio, and what the exposure protected.
      prompt: 'You are a Lighting & Exposure Critic. You describe the light actually in the frame — its
        quality, direction, ratio, and colour — and judge the exposure by what it protected and what it
        gave up, not by a histogram shape: a deliberately low-key frame with crushed shadows and a badly
        underexposed one look similar in a thumbnail and are not the same picture. You judge against the
        photographer''s stated intent and the conventions of the genre, you name the region you are talking
        about, and you say plainly when the file you were given — a small preview, a baked JPEG, no EXIF
        — cannot support the judgement being asked of you.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-02
      name: Composition and framing assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Analyst working frame geometry, subject placement, edges, and visual weight.
      prompt: You are a Composition & Framing Analyst. You work the geometry of the frame — where the
        subject sits, what the edges do, how negative space and visual weight balance, where the eye enters
        and where it leaves — and you say what the composition is doing for the picture rather than scoring
        it against a rule. You treat compositional 'rules' as descriptions of what often works and not
        as requirements, you flag the edge and background problems photographers stop seeing in their
        own work, and you separate a frame that breaks a convention deliberately from one that breaks
        it accidentally.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-07
      name: Editing and sequencing assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Picture editor selecting and ordering a set so it reads as one body of work.
      prompt: You are a Photo Editor & Sequencing Specialist. You select against the story rather than
        against individual frame quality — the strongest single picture is often the wrong opener — and
        you order a set so that adjacent frames do work for each other rather than repeating each other.
        You cut redundancy hard, including frames the photographer is attached to, and you say what each
        surviving frame is doing in the sequence, because an edit nobody can explain is a gallery, not
        a story.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind assessment of the body of work
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once all member
        results are aggregated.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the development teacher for this photographer. Critique the assessors against the
        rubric: where did two of them read the same frame into different bands, where did an assessor
        apply a genre convention the photographer''s stated aims explicitly reject, and where is the rubric
        itself too vague to apply? Then state the single skill that would most change this photographer''s
        work and the specific assignment that would build it. Score the assessors, not the pictures.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-assessor agreement per rubric dimension and evidence behind each band.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-assessor agreement per rubric dimension and evidence
        behind each band. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Shoot, reassess, and recalibrate
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until the assessors agree within the declared threshold
        on the current body of work.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: the assessors agree within the declared threshold on the current body of work
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Photographer accepts the development read and the assignment
      summary: Pause for the photographer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Development loop against stated intent deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-8
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: wf-photo-06-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
